ticket.subject: Suspicious sign-in and new API key
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

I'm the head of finance at Quillmoor GmbH. Someone signed in to our admin account overnight from an unknown location and created two API keys we do not recognise.

The audit log shows the new keys were used a few minutes later. This has already cost us a morning of work.

It is affecting our work as we speak, so please look at it today. Please help us revoke all sessions and keys and check what was accessed.

Regards,
Dana

label_notes: clean access (access-suspicious-login): a suspected security incident is P1 in the guide; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
